title: Sektou / Ils se sont tus
overview: After a long night of work, Smaïl is thinking of only one thing: his bed.  At last, a deep and restful sleep.  But if, unfortunately, that bed happens to be in a street-facing room on the third floor of an apartment building in the center of a Mediterranean city namely Algiers then things will become much more complicated for Smaïl.  Because sleep is a dream, and waking up is a nightmare.
